title: Peace in Islam and Judaism
log: 2026-10-29T12:14:29Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Peace in Islam and Judaism
card: The word Islam comes from the same Arabic root as salam, meaning peace. Muslims teach that peace comes from submission to God, which is what Islam means.
Salam is also a greeting. Muslims say "as-salamu alaykum", meaning "peace be upon you". It shows peace is meant to be shared with others.
In Judaism, shalom means more than the end of conflict. It means peace with wholeness: health, safety and right relationships in a community.
Jewish teaching links peace to justice. The prophets taught that a community cannot be at peace while people are treated unfairly, so Jews are called to pursue justice.
draft.remember: Islam links peace to submission to God. Judaism links peace to wholeness and justice.

a.q: Which statement best describes the Islamic view of how peace is reached?
opts: Through a community free of conflict
Through pursuing justice for the poor
Through freedom from craving and desire
a.why: In Islam, peace comes from submission to God, which is the meaning of the word Islam. Pursuing justice is closer to the Jewish link between shalom and justice, and is not how the card describes the Islamic path to peace.
a.clue: Think about what the word Islam means.

b.q: A Jewish community in Melbourne says a neighbourhood with no fighting but widespread poverty does not yet have shalom. Which idea explains this?
opts: Shalom means wholeness, and is linked to justice
Shalom means only the absence of war or fighting
Shalom means peace through submission to God
Shalom is a greeting and has no wider meaning
b.why: Shalom means peace with wholeness, and Jewish teaching ties it to justice. A place without fighting can still lack wholeness if people are treated unfairly. The idea that shalom is only the absence of war is tempting, but it is too narrow.
b.clue: Is shalom only about the lack of fighting?

b.best: Shalom means wholeness, and is linked to justice

check.summary: No problems found. The facts about the shared root of Islam and salam, the greeting, and shalom as wholeness linked to justice are accurate, and each question has one clear answer.
